description: Defines data structures and classes for managing resource grid allocations in a 5G NR scheduler, including grant info, carrier resource grids, and slot resource management.

classes.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid
classes.description: Represents the symbol x CRB resource grid for a carrier, managing allocations and collisions.

classes.name: cell_slot_resource_grid
classes.description: Manages RB and symbol allocations for a specific slot and cell, across multiple carriers.

classes.name: cell_slot_resource_allocator
classes.description: Stores scheduling info and resource allocations for a specific slot and cell.

classes.name: cell_resource_allocator
classes.description: Circular buffer managing resource allocations over multiple slots, with history support.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Allocates symbol x CRB range or list in the resource grid.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears allocated symbol x CRB range or list in the resource grid.

methods.name: collides
methods.description: Checks for collisions with other allocations in the resource grid.

methods.name: used_crbs
methods.description: Returns bitmap of occupied/unavailable CRBs in the grid.

methods.name: used_prbs
methods.description: Returns bitmap of occupied/unavailable PRBs in the grid.

methods.name: all_set
methods.description: Checks if all specified resources are set in the grid.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates the slot for resource allocation.
